messages:
olivia: Quick sync — AWS + GCP marketplace listings need the final security package and a pen-test window. tagging infra and SI folks. can we agree on what to ship and when?
kevin: I can own the SOC extract and the attestations. target to hand off by next Tue. any blockers?
maria: for pen test, SI partner needs 3 weeks lead time. propose test window 2024-05-15 -> 2024-06-05.
aj: that window ok for infra? we need a maintenance slot for one low-traffic day to run network/ingress scans.
kevin: yep infra ok — prefer weekend of 2024-05-18. aj, can you reserve?
achris: quick note: HW partners (TPM attestation) asked for a digest of firmware inventory + test keys. is that in scope for marketplace bundle?
olivia: yes, we should include a hardware manifest for SI/hw partners but redact customer PHI. keep as separate artifact.
luis: I can create a "security-manifest.json" with checksums and a minimal attestation template. sample manifest: 
```
{
  "component": "tpm-firmware",
  "version": "1.2.3",
  "sha256": "e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb924...",
  "attestation": "HSM-signed-cert-id-1234"
}
```
kevin: perfect. one ask from marketplace review: they want an index of all evidence files + owner and retention period (no presigned link leakage). please add owner email and retention tag to each manifest entry.
sara: about redaction — Security recommends automated scrubbing script before upload. I'll attach the script to the package. simple command: `scripts/scrub-artifacts --redact-ips --exclude-keys=session_token`
reminder-bot: Reminder: pen-test kickoff meeting scheduled 2024-05-10 14:00 (UTC). RSVP required.
olivia: Action items I hear: 
  - kevin: SOC extract + attestations (due 2024-05-07)
  - luis: security-manifest.json with owners + retention tags (due 2024-05-05)
  - aj: reserve maintenance window 2024-05-18 (due 2024-04-30)
  - maria + SI: finalize pen-test scope + timeline (kickoff 2024-05-10)
  - sara: supply redaction script and test run notes (due 2024-05-03)
Can folks confirm?
kevin: confirm. will include redaction checklist in SOC deliverable.
maria: confirm from SI side. will send scope doc by EOD tomorrow.
luis: confirm. will include owner email and retention=3y tag.
aj: reserving 2024-05-18 now.
sara: confirm, will run scrub locally and post results in the thread.
olivia: FYI — marketing asked to hold joint announcement until compliance sign-off + marketplace listing is live. tentative announcement target 2024-06-15.
chris: can we do a final security review one week before announcement? propose 2024-06-08.
olivia: yes final review 2024-06-08. I'll book a 30m slot.
kevin: one more: SI asked for a single S3 location with restricted access (no public presign). we'll produce pre-authenticated transfers for reviewers only.
maria: SI will run tests against a staging endpoint — share creds via vault.
olivia: great. thanks team — I'll update the marketplace checklist doc and ping again when artifacts land. :thumbsup:
